message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ '*' ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]

jobs:

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Update packages repository
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update

      - name: Install libyaml-libyaml-perl
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install libyaml-libyaml-perl

      - name: Install debdiff for debtransform test
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install devscripts

      - name: Install dependencies for pbuild run
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install perl tar psmisc libwww-perl libxml-parser-perl libarchive-tools zstd

      - name: Test debtransform
        run: |
          export LC_ALL=C
          make test test-debtransform

      - name: Test pbuild myself
        run: |
          export BUILD_DIR=$PWD
          export PATH=$PWD:$PATH
          cd dist
          # always use latest branch during CI
          sed -i 's,#%{version},,' build.spec
          # --no-checks since chroot build inside of docker is not working
          pbuild --dist=tumbleweed --orphan --vm-type=podman --no-checks
",
  "rationale": "Adds a custom timeout to the single CI job to bound execution and prevent runaway runner consumption. Recent successful runs complete in about two minutes, so a 30-minute budget provides ample operational headroom while protecting against stuck or hung runs. All existing checkout, dependency installation, and test steps are preserved unchanged, so build and test coverage is intact.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
